ValidationRule.description: Every user can update ParentId field if Parent Account is non-profit. And only Sys Admin, Integration User and Sales Ops can edit ParentId field if Parent Account is not non-profit (https://app.asana.com/0/1201094413545035/1201902348210125/f)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(ParentId), $Profile.Name != 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name != 'Integration User', $Profile.Name != 'Sales Ops', Parent.Non_Profit__c != true )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only set a non-profit Account as a parent
